SELECT d.*, r.role_name AS default_role_name FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON d.default_role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dept.deptName}, '%')
AND d.status = #{dept.status}
ORDER BY d.parent_id, d.sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0
